terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Text: Welcome to MineuQR. By using this website and services provided through it, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. Please read these terms carefully before using the platform. If you do not agree to any of these terms, please do not use our services.
terms.section2Text: MineuQR is a restaurant operating platform that enables restaurants, cafes, and food establishments to create digital menus accessible via QR codes, and to operate ordering channels (including QR ordering, self-ordering kiosk, and waiter tablet), kitchen workflows, and reporting features according to the subscribed plan. The service includes creating and managing digital menus, categorizing items, uploading item images, generating unique QR codes, and providing customer-facing ordering and display experiences.
terms.section3Text1: To use our services, you must create an account through the available authentication system. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account data and for all activities conducted through it. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms.section3Text2: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms or provide false or misleading information.
terms.section4Text1: The platform offers a free trial period of 14 days for all new users. After the trial period ends, you must subscribe to one of the paid plans to continue using the service. Plans differ in terms of the number of restaurants, items, and available features.
terms.section4Text2: Subscriptions are automatically renewed at the end of each billing cycle (monthly or yearly) unless canceled before the renewal date. You can cancel your subscription at any time, and your account will remain active until the end of the current paid period. Billing, cancellation, and refund details are also summarized on the Billing page.
terms.section5Text1: Payments may be made through available payment gateways offered on the platform (currently Tap Payments for card payments and PayPal where available), or by arranging payment directly with our support team via email. Prices are displayed in the currency shown on the Pricing page and may be subject to local taxes depending on your country of residence.
terms.section5Text2: If you are not satisfied with the service within the first 7 days of a paid subscription, you can request a full refund by contacting support at info@mineuqr.com. After this period, no refunds will be issued for the remaining subscription term, unless required by applicable law.
terms.section6Text1: You retain ownership of all content you upload to the platform, including images, texts, and descriptions. By uploading content, you grant us a non-exclusive license to use and display it within the scope of providing the service only.
terms.section6Text2: You represent and warrant that the content you upload does not infringe on the intellectual property rights of any third party and does not contain illegal, offensive, or misleading material.
terms.section7Text: The platform must be used for lawful purposes only and in compliance with applicable laws. It is prohibited to use the platform to publish illegal or offensive content, attempt unauthorized access to our systems, send malware or viruses, or use the service in a way that negatively affects the platform's performance or other users' experience.
terms.section8Text1: The service is provided as is without any express or implied warranties. We do not guarantee that the service will be continuously available or error-free. We are not liable for any direct or indirect damages resulting from the use of the platform.
terms.section8Text2: We reserve the right to modify or suspend any part of the service at any time with reasonable prior notice.
terms.section9Text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. You will be notified of any material changes via email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use of the service after posting modifications means you agree to the modified terms.
terms.section10Text: If you have any questions or inquiries about these Terms of Service, you can contact us via email at

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Text: We at MineuQR are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide when using our platform. By using the platform, you agree to the practices outlined in this policy.
privacy.section2Text1: We collect various types of data to provide and improve our services. The personal data we collect includes: name and email address when creating an account, restaurant information such as name, address, and description, and menu data including item names, descriptions, prices, and images.
privacy.section2Text2: We also automatically collect technical data including IP address, browser type, and operating system, usage data such as pages visited and session duration, and cookies to improve your experience.
privacy.section3Text: We use the collected data to provide and operate the digital menu and ordering service, process payment and subscription transactions, send important notifications about your account and our services, improve platform performance and user experience, provide technical support and respond to your inquiries, and protect the platform from unauthorized use.
privacy.section4Text1: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We may share your data only in the following cases: with trusted service providers who help us operate the platform such as hosting services, file storage (Amazon S3), and payment processors (including Tap Payments and PayPal where used), when responding to legal requirements or court orders, and in case of merger or acquisition with prior notice.
privacy.section4Text2: Menu data (item names, descriptions, prices, and images) is displayed to customers who scan your restaurant's QR code or use your restaurant's ordering channels, which is an essential part of the service nature.
privacy.section5Text1: We take appropriate security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encrypting data in transit using HTTPS protocol, storing images on secure Amazon S3 servers, and using a secure authentication system to protect accounts.
privacy.section5Text2: Your data is stored on secure servers and retained throughout your account's active period. If you delete your account, your personal data will be deleted within 30 days, while retaining legally required data.
privacy.section6Text: We use cookies to improve your experience on the platform. Essential cookies are required for login and session management, and analytical cookies help us understand how the platform is used and improve it. You can control cookie settings through your browser settings, although disabling some may affect platform functionality. For payment, privacy, and security details, also see our Billing and Security pages.
privacy.section7Text: You have the right to access your personal data stored with us, correct any inaccurate data, request deletion of your personal data, object to processing your data for certain purposes, and request a copy of your data in a readable format. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us via email at info@mineuqr.com.
privacy.section8Text: Our services are not directed to persons under 18 years of age. We do not intentionally collect personal data from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately.
privacy.section9Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or through a prominent notice on the platform. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for any updates.
privacy.section10Text: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, you can contact us via email at

hero.title: Building a restaurant operating system for modern venues
hero.description: MineuQR is a restaurant operating platform for digital menus, QR ordering, kiosk and waiter ordering, kitchen workflows, and reporting — with full Arabic and English support.

why.title: Why MineuQR exists
why.description: Restaurants need more than a static menu page. MineuQR exists to connect guest ordering channels with day-to-day operations so teams can run service from one coherent system.

philosophy.description: Our product philosophy is practical: ship durable operational modules, keep bilingual UX first-class, and stay transparent about billing, privacy, and security — without overstating certifications we do not hold.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To help restaurants operate digitally with clarity — menus, ordering, service workflows, and insights working together as one restaurant operating system.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Empower every restaurant and cafe to launch a professional digital menu and connected ordering operations quickly, without requiring a large technical team.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: That Set Us Apart
values.description: We believe in delivering real value to every customer through our core principles

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: We continuously improve ordering channels, operations tooling, and reporting so restaurants can adapt as guest expectations change.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.desc: MineuQR is designed to be usable from day one — launch menus and connected workflows without unnecessary complexity.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.desc: We prioritize secure authentication, HTTPS transport, and careful handling of restaurant and guest data as the foundation of trust.

customer.title: Customer First
customer.desc: We prioritize customer success with responsive support via WhatsApp and email.

docs.body: MineuQR operator documentation and in-product guidance are available inside the authenticated dashboard after login. A separate public developer documentation site is not published yet.
docs.inProductNote: Sign in to access product workflows, or contact us for enterprise onboarding materials.

roadmap.metaDescription: MineuQR product pillars and enterprise roadmap engagement.
roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: What ships today — and how we discuss what comes next.
roadmap.intro: We do not publish speculative feature promises as a public roadmap. Below are capabilities that already ship in production MineuQR.
roadmap.p1: Digital QR menus with bilingual Arabic/English experiences
roadmap.p2: Connected ordering channels including QR, kiosk, and waiter tablet flows
roadmap.p4: Reporting and analytics for restaurant operators
roadmap.p5: Subscription billing via Tap Payments and PayPal where offered
roadmap.forward: Enterprise customers may request a private roadmap discussion based on their operational priorities. We only commit publicly to work that is already shipping or contractually agreed.

statusPage.title: Service Status
statusPage.subtitle: How we communicate service availability.
statusPage.noPublicBody: MineuQR does not currently operate a public third-party status page. Architecture is ready to link an external status URL when configured in public presence settings.
statusPage.externalBody: Live service status is published on our status page.
statusPage.contactText: For suspected outages or urgent service issues, contact
